svg.title: Dragon Database — Silver Atlas desktop hero
svg.desc: A centered silver landing page with the unchanged Swordmaw Hybrid logo, a bold fantasy headline, prominent search, and category shortcuts. Above-the-fold concept at 1440 by 900.
svg.metadata: Landing page hero concept. Illustrative copy and categories. Original v7 Swordmaw Hybrid logo reused with unchanged artwork. Font outlines: Metal Mania and Alegreya Sans, licensed in logos/v7/fonts. Not an implemented application.

g.title: Dragon Database — DB Swordmaw Hybrid
g.desc: Prime dragon and wings with Regalia-inspired ceremonial swords at Prime blade thickness. Metal Mania lettering uses unchanged glyph proportions and adjusted spacing so both Dragon and Database match the full width of the underline sword.
g.metadata: Font: Metal Mania Regular 400. Each word line and underline sword spans x401 to x918, 517 viewBox units. Letter shapes retain uniform scaling.

g.aria-label: Explore dragon lineages, uncover their lore,

g.aria-label: and build a collection worthy of legend.
